summary: Defines extension header formats for the Unidirectional Lightweight Encapsulation (ULE), RFC 4326, and for the Generic Stream Encapsulation (GSE) used in second-generation Digital Video Broadcasting systems. These extensions let IP traffic over broadcast links carry extra information, such as optional fields. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Satellite TV signals can also carry internet data in small packages. This paper defines extra labels you can stick on those packages for added information.
